reason: Noble (noble.xyz, Series A, $18.3M led by Paradigm, 10-20 employees, Etobicoke/Toronto) has only two live openings - General Application and a Head of Product for a brand-new zero-to-one consumer creator-commerce product - and no line in that JD confesses the pain Daniel fixes: there is no engineering-leadership gap (co-founder CTO John Letey is in-house and hands-on), no post-acquisition stack collision, no runaway cloud spend, no reliability/on-call breakdown, and no high-touch human-delivered service to productize; the posting asks for consumer product vision and roadmap ownership, which the dossier explicitly flags as outside his lane ('not a product-zero-to-one CTO, not a consumer-app builder').
